site.name: Blue Collar Rankings
site.tagline: Local trades, ranked. So you call the right pro first.

rankings.hook: Peeling paint, scuffed walls, faded colours. In Vancouver's rain, a paint job has to be done right.
rankings.intro: We looked at seven painting companies in Vancouver, BC, what each one offers and where their experience holds up. Each company is described from its own website, or from its Google listing where a website wasn't available.
winnerWhy: Cambie Painters is licensed, insured and WCB covered, with more than 15 years painting Vancouver homes and businesses. They prep properly before a brush touches the wall and use premium low-VOC paints, inside and out.

Every job comes with a written 2-year workmanship warranty: if the paint peels, blisters or fails, they come back and make it right. Add interiors, exteriors, popcorn ceiling removal and drywall repair under one roof, and it's an easy first call.
tips: Ask exactly what prep is included: washing, scraping, patching, priming.
Ask what the warranty covers and for how long, and get it in writing.
Get a fixed price in writing, not an hourly estimate.
chapters: Why a paint job has to be done right

rankings.hook: A slow drain is a warning. Ignore it, and the next clog shows up as water coming through the basement floor drain.
rankings.intro: We looked at six drain cleaning companies serving the Iowa City area, what each one offers and where their experience holds up. Each company is described from its own website, or from its Google or Facebook listing where a website wasn't available.
winnerWhy: Andy and the A-1 Sewer Service crew clear main sewer lines, kitchen sinks, basement floor drains and bathroom drains. On a main line they open the cleanout and run a cable machine to cut the blockage loose. If the line keeps clogging, they run a camera and show you what's actually in there before anyone starts talking about digging.

They answer 24/7, there are no after-hours fees until 8 p.m. (weekends included), and estimates are free and upfront. For a homeowner staring at a backed-up floor drain, that combination of availability and straight pricing is what put A-1 at the top of this list.
tips: Ask what a camera inspection costs if the line keeps clogging.
Ask about after-hours and weekend fees before you book.
Get the price before the work starts.
chapters: Why a slow drain is a warning

rankings.hook: Hail, straight-line winds, a burst pipe, a flooded basement: in Iowa City, storm and water damage don't wait for a convenient week.
rankings.intro: We looked at eight storm and water damage specialists serving the Iowa City area, what each one focuses on and where their experience holds up. Each company is described from its own website, or from its Google listing where a website wasn't available.
winnerWhy: Michel Cuevas Home Improvement has been family-owned in Iowa City since 1997. On a water damage job they find and fix the source first, whether that's the roof, the siding or a failed pipe. Then they pull wet drywall, flooring and trim, dry the structure, treat the framing to prevent mold, and rebuild it with their own crews. No subcontractors.

After a storm they document hail and wind damage for your insurance adjuster and meet the adjuster on-site. And the number on the estimate is the number on the invoice. Fixing the cause instead of just the stain, plus pricing that doesn't move, is why they earned the top spot.
tips: Ask who finds and fixes the source of the water, not just who dries it out.
Confirm their license and insurance.
Get the estimate in writing, and ask whether they'll meet your adjuster.
chapters: Why storm and water damage can't wait
#1 Top-rated pick: Michel Cuevas Home Improvement

rankings.hook: When a water heater fails, it usually picks a busy morning: cold showers, and maybe a puddle on the basement floor.
rankings.intro: We looked at six Iowa City-area companies that install water heaters, what each one offers and where their experience holds up. Each company is described from its own website, or from its Google listing where a website wasn't available.
winnerWhy: Andy at A-1 Sewer Service installs both tank and tankless water heaters for homes and businesses around Iowa City and the Corridor. Before recommending a unit, he checks the gas supply, the venting and the space the heater has to fit in.

If the gas line or vent has to change, A-1 explains why and builds it into the price up front, so the quote you approve is the job you get. That homework before the sale is exactly what you want when the alternative is cold showers, and it's why A-1 is our top-rated pick. They install across Iowa City, Coralville, North Liberty, Tiffin, Cedar Rapids, West Liberty, Kalona and the Amana Colonies.
tips: Ask whether gas line and venting changes are included in the quote.
Ask whether they haul away the old tank.
Get the quote in writing.

rankings.hook: Breakers that keep tripping, lights that flicker, a panel that can't handle your new EV charger: in Denver, the right electrician makes all the difference.
rankings.intro: We looked at seven Denver-area electricians, what each one focuses on and what their customers say. Each company is described from its own website, or from its Google listing where a website wasn't available.
rankings.method: How we picked #1 here: we compared each company's Google star rating together with how many reviews back it up, so a high rating from a handful of reviews doesn't outrank a near-perfect rating from hundreds.
winnerWhy: Power Electrical, Heating & Cooling Services came out on top with a perfect 5.0 rating across more than 200 Google reviews. That's not a lucky streak from a few happy customers. It's hundreds of Denver-area homeowners saying the same thing.

The work behind the rating covers the whole house: panel upgrades, wiring and rewiring, EV charger installation, lighting, surge protection and troubleshooting, plus heating and cooling. Their site says they've been licensed since 2007, and they serve the Denver metro including Aurora, Littleton, Thornton, Westminster and Arvada.
tips: Confirm their electrical license.
Ask whether permits are included in the price.
Get the price in writing.
chapters: #1 Top-rated pick: Power Electrical, Heating & Cooling Services

rankings.hook: Wild pigs run year-round in Monterey County, and the right outfitter is the difference between a long walk and a full freezer.
rankings.intro: We looked at five guided hunting outfitters working Monterey County and California's Central Coast, what each one offers and where their experience holds up. Each outfitter is described from its own website, or from its HuntLease listing where it has no website.
winnerWhy: Indian Valley Outfitters, based in San Miguel, runs guided and unguided hunts on private ranch land in Monterey and Santa Clara counties that's run under a game management program. Hunts cover year-round wild pig, blacktail deer, turkey, quail, dove and more, and hunters can stay in a three-bedroom ranch home on the property.

Their guarantee is in writing on their website: professional guides, reliable transportation in the field and game-managed private land, and if they fall short of that, they'll work with you to make it right. Every outfitter here has real strengths, so watch the full breakdown and make your own call.
tips: Ask exactly what's included: lodging, meals, processing, taxidermy.
Confirm the guide is licensed with the California Department of Fish and Wildlife.
Get the price and deposit terms in writing. California requires nonlead ammunition for hunting.

rankings.hook: Clear glass looks great until everyone can see into your office, your conference room or your home. Privacy frost film fixes that without replacing the glass, and it still lets the light in.
rankings.intro: We looked at six Los Angeles window film installers, what each one focuses on and where their experience holds up. Each company is described from its own website.
winnerWhy: MD Window Films is a Santa Monica window film contractor that has been open since 2010 and is an Armorcoat certified dealer. Frosted privacy film is a core service, alongside security, anti-graffiti and solar films and window tinting, for commercial and residential buildings across Greater Los Angeles.

Privacy without giving up daylight is the whole point of frost film, and it's the job MD Window Films does every day. Every installer here has real strengths, so compare samples and warranties before you decide. MD Window Films is where we'd start.
tips: Ask which film brand and product they install.
Find out what the warranty covers, and for how long.
Ask to see samples on your glass, and get the price in writing.

rankings.hook: Remodeling a kitchen in Malibu means salt air, hillside lots and coastal permits, and the wrong contractor can turn it into an expensive project.
rankings.intro: We looked at six Malibu-area kitchen remodelers, what each one focuses on and where their experience holds up. Each company is described from its own website. Some focus on kitchens and baths; others also handle additions, ADUs and full custom homes.
winnerWhy: All Exclusive Construction is a licensed remodeling contractor (CA Lic. #1120170) with a page built specifically for Malibu kitchens. It covers remodels for coastal and hillside homes, including materials chosen to stand up to salt air and coordination with City of Malibu permits and, when needed, the California Coastal Commission.

They also handle bathrooms, additions and ADUs, work out of offices in Santa Monica and Westlake Village, and offer free in-home consultations. Every remodeler in this ranking has real strengths, so compare two or three before you sign. All Exclusive Construction is our top-rated pick.
tips: Confirm their California contractor license.
Ask who pulls the permits, especially for coastal-zone work.
Get the price and timeline in writing.
chapters: Why Malibu kitchens need the right contractor
